blocks.text: Grade 10 高频词汇 301–400
orthodox /'ɒːθədɒks/ adj. 正统的, 传统的, 惯常的
It is an important ceremony marking the confirmed's commitment to their faith in the Catholic, Eastern Orthodox, Episcopal and Anglican churches, as well as in several Protestant denominations.
中文语境：这是一个重要的仪式，标志着确认者对天主教、东正教、圣公会和英国圣公会以及几个新教教派的信仰的承诺
elevate /'eliveit/ v.t. 举起, 提拔, 鼓舞
Some prefer to have a simple birthday party of elevated importance with friends and family instead.
中文语境：有些人更喜欢与朋友和家人举办一个简单的、重要的生日聚会
infuse /in'fjuːz/ v.t. 注入, 使充满, 泡制, 鼓舞；v.i. 泡

...reflecting unmistakable African ancestry, to the assertion of growing links with Black Africa - the passionate belief in which infused all the writings of Lorraine Hansberry, from her first play, set in Chicago, to her last, set in Africa.
中文语境：...反映了明显的非洲血统，以及与黑非洲日益增长的联系的断言--洛林·汉斯伯里的所有作品都充满了这种热情的信念，从她以芝加哥为背景的第一部戏剧，到以非洲为背景的最后一部戏剧
reverberate /ri'vəːbəreit/ v.i. 回响, 反响, 被反射；v.t. 使反响, 使回响, 反射；adj. 回响的, 反射的
And all the while the confluence of the Black experience and that Irish wail she had heard "in a different key" continued to reverberate within.
中文语境：黑人的经历和她"以不同的调"听到的爱尔兰哀号的融合一直在内心持续回响
irreverent /i'revərənt/ adj. 不敬的, 不逊的, 无礼的
What's remarkable about 1905 is that a single person authored all five papers, plus the original, irreverent way Einstein came to his conclusions.
中文语境：1905 年的非凡之处在于，所有五篇论文都是由一个人撰写的，而且爱因斯坦得出结论的方式也是原创的、不敬的
beholden /bi'həudən/ adj. 负有义务的, 受惠的
He wasn't beholden to a thesis advisor or any other authority figure." His mind was free to roam accordingly.
中文语境：他并不受制于论文导师或任何其他权威人物。"他的思想可以自由地漫游
wroth /rɒːθ/ adj. 激怒的, 愤怒的
Then the old man waxed wroth and abusive.
中文语境：然后，老人变得愤怒并辱骂
drowse /drauz/ n. 瞌睡；v.i. 打瞌睡；v.t. 使瞌睡
There was a sudden leap and stir of blood that had been asleep for an hour, and as sudden a rousing of all the drowsing activities in our minds and bodies.
中文语境：沉睡了一个小时的血液突然跳跃起来，我们的思想和身体中所有沉睡的活动也突然苏醒
consternation /.kɒnstə'neiʃən/ n. 惊愕, 恐怖, 惊惶失措
We were alive and awake at once - and shaking and quaking with consternation, too.
中文语境：我们立刻就醒了，还活着--也因惊愕而颤抖
lusty /'lʌsti/ adj. 健壮的, 精力充沛的
Sap check'd with frost and lusty leaves quite gone,
中文语境：树液被霜冻住了，精力充沛的叶子也消失了，
confound /kən'faund/ v.t. 使混淆, 使狼狈, 挫败
To hideous winter and confounds him there;
中文语境：可怕的冬天使他在那里感到困惑；
substance /'sʌbstəns/ n. 物质, 实质, 主旨, 资产, 本质, 牢固；[化] 物质
Leese but their show; their substance still lives sweet.
中文语境：Leese不过是他们的表演；他们的物质仍然甜蜜
prisoner /'priznə/ n. 囚犯, 犯人, 战俘；[法] 犯人, 囚犯, 扣押犯
A liquid prisoner pent in walls of glass,
中文语境：一个被关在玻璃墙里的液体囚犯，
metamorphose /.metə'mɒːfəuz/ v.t. 使变形, 使变态, 使变质；v.i. 变形, 变质

My two English daughters thought it was magic, the way the cranberries gently burst from their skins and released their juices to metamorphose into something that to me felt onomatopoeic, if you can use that word to describe such a perfect confluence of color and taste.
中文语境：我的两个英国女儿认为这很神奇，蔓越莓轻轻地从果皮中破裂出来，释放出汁液，变形成对我来说感觉拟声的东西，如果你能用这个词来形容颜色和味道的完美融合的话
adulterate /ə'dʌltəreit/ v.t. 掺杂；adj. 掺假的, 假的, 通奸的

I jettisoned all the traditions I'd never cared for: creamed onions, squabbling ancillary relatives, overly marshmallowy yams and the sort of cranberry sauce adulterated by the needless addition of orange zest.
中文语境：我抛弃了所有我从来不关心的传统：奶油洋葱、争吵的辅助亲戚、过度棉花糖的山药和那种不必要地添加橙皮的蔓越莓酱
putrid /'pjuːtrid/ adj. 腐败的；[医] 腐败的, 恶臭的
Cleanse the one with a gnawing and putrid gangrene, so sickening, so offensive,
中文语境：净化那个带有啃咬和腐烂坏疽的人，如此令人作呕，如此令人反感，
abdomen /'æbdəmen/ n. 腹部；[医] 腹[部]
The fractur'd thigh, the knee, the wound in the abdomen,
中文语境：骨折的大腿、膝盖、腹部的伤口，
clot /klɒt/ n. 凝块, 一团；v. (使)凝结, (使)聚集
Soon to be fill'd with clotted rags and blood, emptied, and fill'd again.
中文语境：很快就会被凝结的破布和血充满，清空，然后再次充满
impassive /im'pæsiv/ adj. 无感情的, 冷淡的, 无感觉的, 不能伤害的
These and more I dress with impassive hand, (yet deep in my breast a fire, a burning flame.)
中文语境：这些以及更多的东西我用冷漠的手穿着，（但我的胸膛深处有一团火，一团燃烧的火焰。）
resume /ri'zjuːm/ v.t. 重新开始, 取回, 恢复；v.i. 再开始；n. 摘要, 个人简历；[计] 继续执行
Returning, resuming, I thread my way through the hospitals,
中文语境：回来，继续，我穿过医院，
chronology /krə'nɔlədʒi/ n. 年代学, 资料按年月次序的排列, 按时间顺序编制的表格, 年表
But improved techniques and calibration, McLean says, "helped us go from million-year uncertainties to tight chronologies."
中文语境：但是，麦克莱恩说，改进的技术和校准"帮助我们从数百万年的不确定性转向严格的年代学"
wallop /'wɒləp/ v.i. 乱窜, 猛冲；v.t. 猛击, 击溃；n. 重击, 冲击力, 快感
But the asteroid wasn't the only catastrophe to wallop the planet around this time.
中文语境：但这颗小行星并不是此时袭击地球的唯一灾难
convoy /'kɒnvɒi. kən'vɒi/ n. 护送, 护卫；v.t. 护航, 护送
The defiant gesture - a 110 mile-long convoy - was closely watched by East German police, but it did not provoke any immediate response.
中文语境：这一挑衅姿态--一支110英里长的车队--受到东德警方的密切关注，但并没有立即引起任何反应
abrupt /ə'brʌpt/ adj. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不连贯的

The American answer to the abrupt closure of the East German border was designed to avoid an outright clash with the Red Army stationed in GDR while accomplishing two main goals: maintain a free access to, and presence in, Western sectors of Berlin; and keep up the pressure for the removal of The Berlin Wall.
中文语境：美国对突然关闭东德边境的回应旨在避免与驻扎在东德的红军发生彻底冲突，同时实现两个主要目标：保持自由进入和驻扎柏林西区；并继续施压拆除柏林墙
birthright /'bəːθrait/ n. 生来就有的权利, 长子继承权
a boy who steals his brother's birthright
中文语境：一个男孩偷走了他兄弟的与生俱来的权利
genre /'ʒɒŋrə/ n. 类型, 流派
The genre is dead.
中文语境：这种流派已经死了
fantasy /'fæntəsi/ n. 幻想, 想象的产物；[医] 幻想
This is not fantasy, this is our life.
中文语境：这不是幻想，这就是我们的生活
invade /in'veid/ v.t. 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭；[法] 强入, 侵犯, 侵略
who have invaded the moon,
中文语境：谁入侵了月球，
meteoric /.miːti'ɒrik/ adj. 流星的, 疾速的, 大气的

Now, after a lucky career break and a meteoric rise on the staff of the Chicago Defender , she stood nervously before the president as one of only three accredited African Americans in the White House press corps.
中文语境：现在，在经历了一次幸运的职业突破和在《芝加哥卫报》的工作人员中迅速崛起后，她作为白宫记者团中仅有的三名获得认可的非裔美国人之一，紧张地站在总统面前
emissary /'emisəri/ n. 密使, 间谍, 使者；adj. 充当密使的, 充当间谍的
Payne saw herself both as an emissary from and a representative of a large group of Americans long neglected by the mainstream media.
中文语境：佩恩将自己视为长期被主流媒体忽视的一大群美国人的使者和代表
accredit /ə'kredit/ v.t. 信托, 确认, 归结于, 委派；[经] 发行信用证, 信托, 委托

Now, after a lucky career break and a meteoric rise on the staff of the Chicago Defender , she stood nervously before the president as one of only three accredited African Americans in the White House press corps.
中文语境：现在，在经历了一次幸运的职业突破和在《芝加哥卫报》的工作人员中迅速崛起后，她作为白宫记者团中仅有的三名获得认可的非裔美国人之一，紧张地站在总统面前
gladiator /'glædieitə/ n. 斗士, 斗剑者, 争论者
"Instead," she told her readers, "this gladiator going into battle wears a reverse collar, a flowing robe, and carries a Bible in his hand."
中文语境："相反，"她告诉读者，"这位参加战斗的角斗士穿着反领、飘逸的长袍，手里拿着一本圣经。"
haphazardly /.hæp'hæzədli/ adv. 偶然地, 随意地；杂乱地

Each time I passed by them on the freeway, I found myself feeling more and more contempt for whoever took the time out of their day to haphazardly scrawl words and patterns all over John Wehrle's "Galileo, Jupiter, Apollo" or Frank Romero's "Going to the Olympics." But upon a recent drive through that stretch of freeway that the murals call home, I...
中文语境：每次我在高速公路上经过它们时，我发现自己越来越鄙视那些花时间在约翰·韦尔勒的《伽利略、木星、阿波罗》或弗兰克·罗梅罗的《走向奥运会》上随意涂写文字和图案的人。但最近，当我开车穿过那段壁画称之为家的高速公路时，我......
colloquial /kə'ləukwiəl/ adj. 会话的, 口语的, 口语体的

To my understanding, there have always been two separate types of art: 'high' art, or works by well-known and well-established artists that have made their homes in numerous 2 3 prestigious spaces, and 'low' art, or works that exist in less formal, more colloquial spheres of society.
中文语境：据我了解，一直有两种不同类型的艺术："高雅"艺术，即知名且知名的艺术家的作品，这些艺术家在众多 2-3 个享有盛誉的空间中安家；"低俗"艺术，即存在于不太正式、更通俗的社会领域的作品
palatable /'pælətəbl/ adj. 美味的, 好吃的, 可口的；[医] 适口的, 味美的

Unless found palatable by the artistic elite, like in the case of Banksy, they're condemned to exist as 'low art,' forever trapped behind the impossibly high barrier to entry set by critics, curators and collectors all over the country.
中文语境：除非像班克斯那样被艺术精英所接受，否则它们注定会作为"低级艺术"而存在，永远被困在全国各地的评论家、策展人和收藏家设置的难以置信的高门槛后面
scrawl /skrɒːl/ v.t. 潦草地写；v.i. 乱写；n. 潦草的笔迹

...by them on the freeway, I found myself feeling more and more contempt for whoever took the time out of their day to haphazardly scrawl words and patterns all over John Wehrle's "Galileo, Jupiter, Apollo" or Frank Romero's "Going to the Olympics." But upon a recent drive through that stretch of freeway that the murals call home, I began...
中文语境：...在高速公路上，我发现自己越来越鄙视那些花时间在约翰·韦尔勒的《伽利略、木星、阿波罗》或弗兰克·罗梅罗的《参加奥运会》上随意涂写文字和图案的人。但最近，当我开车穿过那段壁画称之为家的高速公路时，我开始......
deliberation /di.libə'reiʃən/ n. 熟虑, 熟思, 审议；[法] 慎重考虑, 商讨, 审议
After further deliberation, I decided it was a question of context.
中文语境：经过进一步的思考，我认为这是一个背景问题
monotony /mə'nɒtəni/ n. 单调, 缺乏变化
I remember the monotony.
中文语境：我记得单调
vie /vai/ v.i. 争, 竞争, 争胜；v.t. 提出...来竞争, 以...作较量
In the aftermath of a fierce battle, two men who were vying to rule Thebes, Eteocles and Polyneices, have both died.
中文语境：在一场激烈的战斗之后，争夺底比斯统治权的两名男子埃忒奥克勒斯和波吕涅刻斯双双阵亡
degenerate /di'dʒenəreit/ adj. 堕落的；v.i. 退化, 堕落；v.t. 使变质, 使退化

It raises questions about personal conscience, choosing to do what you think is right regardless of what the law says, and weighing that against whether the law is necessary in order to keep society from degenerating into anarchy and chaos.
中文语境：它提出了关于个人良心的问题，无论法律如何规定，选择做你认为正确的事情，并权衡法律是否有必要以防止社会陷入无政府状态和混乱
rehearsal /ri'həːsl/ n. 预演, 排演, 练习, 叙述, 复述；[法] 详述, 列举事实, 复述
"We haven't really turned any rehearsals into a discussion of the characters' political viewpoints or the way they oppose each other," he says.
中文语境："我们并没有真正将任何排练变成对角色政治观点或他们相互对立方式的讨论，"他说
adaptation /.ædæp'teiʃən/ n. 适应, 改编, 改编本；[医] 适应[作用]
That's probably why the tragedy has endured, and why new adaptations keep popping up.
中文语境：这可能就是这场悲剧持续存在的原因，也是新的改编作品不断涌现的原因
affront /ə'frʌnt/ n. 公开侮辱, 轻蔑；v.t. 公开侮辱, 冒犯, 面对
The totalitarian world finds even symbols of love and of worship an affront.
中文语境：极权主义世界甚至认为爱和崇拜的象征都是一种侮辱
unalterable /ʌn'ɒːltərəbl/ adj. 不能改变的, 不变的, 固定不移的；[法] 不变的, 不能改变的
For I join you, as I join your fellow countrymen in the West, in this firm, this unalterable belief: Es gibt nur ein Berlin.
中文语境：因为我和你们一起，就像我和你们西方同胞一样，坚定地、不可改变地相信：Es gibt nur ein Berlin
tariff /'tærif/ n. 关税, 关税表, 价格表, 收费表；v.t. 课以关税；[计] 价目表
The German leaders - the German leaders reduced tariffs, expanded free trade, lowered taxes.
中文语境：德国领导人--德国领导人降低了关税，扩大了自由贸易，降低了税收
gut /gʌt/ n. 剧情, 内容, 内脏, 肚子, 海峡, 勇气；v.t. 取出内脏, 毁坏...的内部
I was struck by a sign - the sign on a burnt-out, gutted structure that was being rebuilt.
中文语境：我被一个标志震惊了--这个标志位于一座正在重建的烧毁、损毁的建筑上
ephemeral /i'femərəl/ adj. 朝生暮死的, 短命的, 短暂的；[医] 暂时的
not to speak of timely and wondrous rain falling upon ephemeral mountains,
中文语境：更不用说及时而奇妙的降雨落在短暂的山上，
nebulous /'nebjuləs/ adj. 星云的, 星云状的, 朦胧的
nor to dwell on rare and unexpected footsteps echoing through nebulous valleys,
中文语境：也不要沉迷于在云雾缭绕的山谷中回响的罕见和意想不到的脚步声，
indestructible /.indi'strʌktəbl/ adj. 不能破坏的, 不可毁灭的
the universe is a particle of indestructible dust drifting in the air.
中文语境：宇宙是飘浮在空气中的一粒坚不可摧的尘埃
predictable /pri'diktəbl/ adj. 可预言的
here's yet another predictable batch of grainy residue,
中文语境：这是另一批可预测的颗粒状残留物，
justifiable /'dʒʌstifaiəbl/ adj. 可辩解的, 可证明的, 有理的；[法] 正当的, 不可非议的, 可办明的

From a persuasion that equal liberty was originally the Portion, It is still the Birthright of all men, & influenced by the strong ties of Humanity & the Principles of their Institution, your Memorialists conceive themselves bound to use all justifiable endeavours to loosen the bounds of Slavery and promote a general Enjoyment of the blessings of Freedom.
中文语境：相信平等自由最初是人的一部分，现在仍然是所有人与生俱来的权利，并受到人性的牢固联系及其机构原则的影响，你们的纪念主义者认为自己有义务利用一切合理的努力来放松奴隶制的界限并促进普遍享受自由的祝福
denomination /di.nɒmi'neiʃən/ n. 名称, 教派, 面额；[经] 票面金额, 名称, (度量衡)

That from a regard for the happiness of Mankind an Association was formed several years since in this State by a number of her Citizens of various religious denominations for promoting the Abolition of Slavery & for the relief of those unlawfully held in bondage.
中文语境：出于对人类幸福的考虑，几年后，来自不同宗教派别的一些公民在本州成立了一个协会，以促进废除奴隶制并救济那些被非法奴役的人
salutary /'sæljutəri/ adj. 有益的, 有用的, 有益健康的；[医] 适于健康的

They have observed with great Satisfaction that many important & salutary Powers are vested in you for "promoting the Welfare & Securing the blessings of liberty to the 'People of the United States.'" And as they conceive, that these blessings ought rightfully to be...
中文语境：他们非常满意地观察到，许多重要且有益的权力被赋予给你，以"促进'美国人民'的福利并确保自由的祝福。"正如他们所认为的，这些祝福应该理所当然地......
servile /'səːvail/ adj. 奴隶的, 奴性的, 卑屈的

...in this land of Freedom, are degraded into perpetual Bondage, and who, amidst the general Joy of surrounding Freemen, are groaning in Servile Subjection, that you will devise means for removing this Inconsistency from the Character of the American People, that you will promote mercy and Justice towards this distressed Race, & that you will...
中文语境：...在这片自由的土地上，他们被贬为永久的奴役，他们在周围自由人的普遍喜悦中，在奴役中呻吟，你们将想出办法消除美国人民性格中的这种不一致，你们将促进对这个受苦的种族的仁慈和正义，你们将......
omit /əu'mit/ v.t. 省略, 删除, 疏忽, 遗漏；[化] 省略
...in the pleasing expectation, that nothing, which can be done for the relive of the unhappy objects of their care, will be either omitted or delayed.
中文语境：...在令人愉快的期望中，为重温他们所照顾的不幸对象而做的任何事情都不会被遗漏或延迟
preview /'priːvjuː/ n. 事先查看, 预览；v.t. 事先查看, 预演；[计] 预览
In the past, governments in many different parts of the world, often during times of war, have used everything from newspaper articles to movie previews to disperse propaganda.
中文语境：过去，世界许多不同地区的政府常常在战争时期利用从报纸文章到电影预告等各种手段来进行宣传
disseminate /di'semineit/ v.t. 散播, 传播, 宣传；v.i. 广为传播
Anyone who intentionally spreads misinformation for political purposes is disseminating propaganda.
